scope: Fix the defects verified by the October 14 read-only critique of Pages 24-29, using copies only.
policy: Every change was made on a new page. Pages 16 and 24-29 were not edited.
Components were forked with clone(); copied screens were re-pointed at the forks, so each fix lives in one forked component.
Every write was guarded to refuse any node outside the new page.
No existing repository file was changed; this record is a new file.

rebinding.note: The remapped text styles have identical metrics, so the remap changes ownership, not appearance.

newPage.method: Layout boxes for frames and instances, ink bounds for text, checked against every auto-layout parent; chip children checked for overlap and for leaving the chip. Effects such as drop shadows are excluded.

originalsUnchanged.method: Fingerprints (node count, geometry, text, paints and bindings) taken before any write and recomputed after all writes; page section counts compared.
originalsUnchanged.mediaBarSet: 1347:84311 has 14 variants; the Desktop and Compact paused variant trees match the pre-change record.

verification.visual: Each fixed screen was cropped from a full-resolution section render and inspected; forked chips were inspected at 3x.

notInScope: The originals still bind the legacy Model, Editing and Current UI collections. Adopting the fixes means swapping instances on the original pages, which this pass did not do.
Copied screens keep their prototype reactions, which still navigate to frames on the original pages.
C34's unavailable Remove background menu item still uses 40% opacity for its disabled state.
The Centered full toolbar frames are 40px while the toolbar drop shadow extends further; this is shadow ink, not layout overflow, and is unchanged from the originals.
The remaining critique findings (editor overlays, area editing, icon semantics, copy, docs content, file organisation) were not part of this fix list.
